title: SP42 reason catalog
description: Per-project, per-language wording for verdict reason codes (ADR-0031 §4). One file per (wiki_id, language). The keys under `reasons` are the same machine-legible codes a ruleset declares statically on its outcome arms, and are what `disallowed_reasons` matches against; the template is the only place human wording lives.

wiki_id.description: The project this catalog is for, e.g. frwiki.

language.description: BCP-47-ish language tag. Coverage is enforced per language: a code a configured ruleset can produce must be present in every language that project ships, or that language does not load.

reasons.description: Reason code -> wording. Every placeholder used by a template must be declared in that entry's `params`, and every declared parameter must be used by the template; both directions are load errors, not runtime surprises.

propertyNames.description: Reason codes are lower-case snake_case. A project may not ship a ruleset whose reasons render as machine identifiers, so a code with no entry is a load error rather than a fallback.

template.description: The human-readable sentence. All grammar and word order belong here and never to a parameter (ADR-0031 §5), so a translation needs this file and nothing else. Placeholders are written {name}.

params.description: Placeholder names this template substitutes. Must be exactly the set of {name} placeholders in `template`.
